stem:
The spinner shown is divided into congruent sections that are labeled from 1 through 7.

If the spinner is spun one time, what is the probability of the arrow not landing on a section labeled with an odd number?
visual_elements: A circular spinner divided into 7 congruent sections labeled 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 with an arrow pointing at section 4.
